note: Small City of Sumner campground in the community park at the south edge of town, near Swan Lake National Wildlife Refuge: a row of six angled pull-through pads beside the park drive. Nothing is published by the city; the only camper report is from 2021, so call ahead. --Claude
summary: Presence is thin: no city web page, no fee published, one camper report (December 2021, $25) and an unclaimed RV Life row that carries a phone, 660-856-3364. The six pads are real on imagery. DROP CANDIDATE / owner question on the presence test; nothing written to the fields. Pin is 70 m east of the pad row.
flags: PRESENCE - DROP CANDIDATE, OWNER TO DECIDE: (1) No operator page: three searches found no City of Sumner website, park page, ordinance or fee notice; Google Maps has no place for the campground (the name search returns Sumner Lake State Park in New Mexico) and only an unnamed locality point for the park. (2) RV Life row 252431: type 'City Park', 6 sites, unclaimed, no reviews, no rate (avg_rate 0), record data dated 2018, status reason 'Robocall Response'; it lists phone 660-856-3364 (a Sumner exchange number - not called, not confirmed as the city's). (3) Campendium: one review, 5.0, dated December 27, 2021, 'Nightly Rate $25.00, Days Stayed 6, Site Number 4', 'Reservations: No', hookups listed '30 Amp, Sewer', 'Big rigs'. Nothing dated 2024 or later anywhere. (4) Ground truth: imagery shows six parallel angled gravel/concrete pull-through pads, each about 20 x 5 m, on the north side of the park drive west of the red-roofed shelter - a built RV row, so the campground physically exists. Under 'add with a caveat' a real municipal row stays with the caveat in the note; under the presence test (no page, no confirmed phone, no current fee, no recent report) it is a drop. Kept for now with nothing written.
FEES (not written): the only figure is the 2021 camper report of $25 a night. It is older than the 2024 cut-off for camper-reported rates, so no fee is written.

HOOKUPS CONFLICT (not written): stored electric 30, water false, sewer false ('no water or sewer at the sites yet'). Campendium's listing shows '30 Amp' and 'Sewer' under hookups and no water. No operator source for either; stored values left alone.
PHONE (none stored; apply.py does not write it): RV Life lists 660-856-3364. Unverified - no city page shows it.
PIN MOVE (small): stored 39.65357,-93.24581 is on the playground. The pad row is 70 m west, centred about 39.65351,-93.24659 (Campendium's own point 39.653400,-93.246948 falls on the same row).
WEBSITE: the stored website is the RV Life listing, the only page there is. No operator URL exists to replace it.
